title: Velvety Poke Bowl
description: A refreshing poke bowl made with velvety tofu and topped with a tangy sauce. Perfect for a light lunch or dinner.

ingredients.name: Brazilian-Style Sea Salt
ingredients.notes: adds a nice depth of flavor

ingredients.name: Myeolchi (Korean Mung Bean Sprouts)
ingredients.notes: adds a nice crunch and texture

instructions: Cut the velvety tofu into small cubes.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the miso, rice vinegar, and soy sauce.
Add the Brazilian-Style Sea Salt and whisk until dissolved.
Add the chopped green onions and toasted sesame seeds to the bowl and mix well.
Add the cubed tofu to the bowl and toss to coat with the sauce.
Divide the cooked rice into bowls and top with the tofu mixture.
Add the myeolchi, poke sauce, and any additional toppings you like.
